name: @breeze/editor
//ag-psd: PSD import, loaded through a dynamic import in state/psd-file.ts so it lands in its own chunk. It is large and most sessions never open a PSD; a static import would put it in the main bundle for everyone. Parsing client-side is deliberate — it keeps a rich binary format parser off the server's upload path, which is the Wave 0 rule the sequence zip reader is the only exception to. NOTE: these `//name` notes belong at the top level of the manifest, never inside `dependencies` — pnpm validates every key in there as a package name and refuses the whole workspace.
//gsap: Kept only so Vite can resolve the alias target and the types when it builds @breeze/runtime's dist. Nothing under src/ imports GSAP directly. Keep the ~3.15.0 pin equal to packages/runtime's — two different resolutions in one workspace would give the editor preview and the /play page different animation engines, and the whole point of one shared renderer is that the preview shows what goes to air.
